sources.use: Annual clinical review is distinct from routine asymptomatic endometrial ultrasound/biopsy.

findings.finding: Significant past thromboembolic disease was not encoded as an NCCP exclusion; only active/recent VTE was considered.
findings.change: Added independent history exclusion, separate acute symptom pathway, and visible difference from the less restrictive product risk–benefit text.

findings.finding: Severe hepatic impairment previously produced only generic review without stating that treatment is not recommended.
findings.change: Withhold for review with the exact no-recommendation source position; mild/moderate and renal/dialysis no-adjustment pathways kept separate.

findings.finding: No current QT-risk assessment or follow-up ECG timing was available.
findings.change: Added risk-triggered ECG/electrolytes, repeat ECG at steady state (at least4weeks), and follow-up based on symptoms/interacting medicines; no invented QT numerical cutoff.

findings.finding: Abnormal vaginal bleeding and generic CTCAE grade≥3 previously triggered an automatic treatment hold that NCCP does not specify.
findings.change: Prompt gynaecology/individual toxicity review; retained explicit acute clot/SCAR/hepatic/pregnancy safety restrictions.

findings.finding: Medicine review lacked coumarin interaction/INR, concurrent anastrozole, CYP3A4 induction and surgical risk distinctions.
findings.change: Source-specific actions, no blanket warfarin contraindication for cancer treatment and no universal six-week perioperative stop rule.

findings.finding: Only two legacy rules were present: generic grade3 haematology review and generic severe liver review. Child-Pugh B reduction was absent.
findings.change: Replaced with22source-linked rules; Child-Pugh B shows250mg peradministration and Child-Pugh C gives no-dose exclusion.

findings.finding: Dose schedule had no structured loading/ongoing phases.
findings.change: Added500mg D1/D15 first28-daycycle, then D1q28 as currentNCCP; two5mL IMinjections taking1–2min each.

findings.finding: NCCP CPB250mg differs from EMA no adjustment for mild/moderate hepatic disease.
findings.change: Keep NCCP recommendation explicit with product discrepancy and mandatory Consultant/pharmacy reconciliation in displayed explanation.
findings.source: NCCP p2 Table1 versus EMA Faslodex §4.2

findings.finding: IM bleeding/anticoagulant caution and nerve injury warning were missing.
findings.change: Added named caution inputs; did not invent ANC or platelet hold thresholds. Numeric blood counts remain monitoring-only.

findings.finding: Post-menopausal/ER/prior-endocrine eligibility and ECOG0–2 were not assessed.
findings.change: Independent optional eligibility checks, no absent-as-normal assumptions; keep narrower NCCP indications visibly distinct from broader EMA endocrine-naive licence.

findings.finding: Source pagecounts incorrectly recorded6, with legacy source-maturity flags.
findings.change: Current PDFs both4pages; metadata sourcechecked2026-10-18; independent clinical and pharmacy approval flags remainfalse.

limits: No interactive browser walkthrough in this delegated audit.
Drug-specific clinical scenarios do not validate individual patient treatment decisions.
Other regimens and combination rules were not modified.
